semiconductor_relevance: High — ACE provides critical fluid measurement and control technologies essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: ACE specializes in fluid measurement, control, and monitoring technologies tailored for the semiconductor industry. The company offers a range of components and application equipment, including exhaust pressure controllers, mass flow controllers, and high-precision reference flow calibrators, which are integral to assembly and packaging processes.
capabilities: EPS5000 Series exhaust pressure controller/flow meter
AFC150 and AFC250 mass flow controllers
Flow calibration services and gas mixing devices
